title: France unrest
summary: A cost-of-living and schools protest movement turned into France's worst unrest in years on 17 October. Macron blamed far-left groups and criminals, and the government is now asking towns to impose partial curfews; similar clashes have broken out in Milan.

background.text: Student protests over school conditions build into a wider cost-of-living movement backed by unions.
National day of action over living costs and schools: 550,000–800,000 march, with looting and arson in many cities and more than 1,200 arrests reported that night.
